claims.claim: EMCOR reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.15B, up 19.8% year over year, operating income of $547.3M at a 10.6% margin, and diluted EPS of $9.06, up 34.8%.
Remaining performance obligations reached a record $17.14B, up 43.9%, and management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $20.0B-$20.5B and diluted EPS guidance to $32.00-$33.25.

risks.risk: Large remaining performance obligations support visibility but do not guarantee timing, margin realization or absence of project execution/cost pressure.

unknowns.unknown: This source alone does not disaggregate how much backlog growth is organic versus acquisition-related or quantify hyperscale/data-center concentration.

claims.claim: The simultaneous records in revenue, operating income, EPS and remaining performance obligations plus a substantial upward 2026 guidance revision are direct evidence that execution was running ahead of prior management expectations in Q2 2026.

risks.risk: Raised guidance increases the future execution bar and makes project mix, labor availability and cost control important falsifiers.

unknowns.unknown: No independent customer-level corroboration was acquired in this pass.
